features.heading: Everything you need to understand your AI workflow.

items.title: AI vs manual attribution
items.desc: Automatically detect what came from Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT — and what you typed yourself.

items.title: Real coding time
items.desc: Active focus minutes, not just calendar time. Idle, context-switching, and reading are measured separately.

items.title: By language & project
items.desc: Heatmaps, breakdowns by repo and file extension. See where AI helps and where you write everything by hand.

items.title: Privacy by design
items.desc: We never store your prompts, code, or screen content. Only event metadata. Self-host the whole stack if you want.

items.title: AI-generated reports
items.desc: Weekly and monthly summaries from Gemini — what changed, where you sped up, what to focus on next.

items.title: Built for teams
items.desc: Invite-only teams, role-based access, per-project breakdowns for engineering managers.

how.heading: From install to insight in under five minutes.

items.title: Install the agent
items.desc: One binary on macOS or Windows. VS Code & Claude Code hooks ship as separate plugins.

items.title: Sign in
items.desc: Email + password or GitHub OAuth. Invite-only team mode keeps your org private.

items.title: Code as usual
items.desc: Agent classifies events locally. Only metadata leaves your machine — never code or prompts.

items.title: Read the dashboard
items.desc: Live charts, language breakdown, AI-generated reports. Cancel anytime, export anytime.

pricing.heading: Free for the first 3 companies. Forever for solo devs.
pricing.lead: We onboard 3 founding companies free of charge — no credit card, no trial countdown, no seat caps. Self-hosted is free for everyone.

items.q: What does the agent actually collect?
items.a: Only metadata: focused app, idle/active state, paste sizes, language extensions, AI provider names. Never prompts, code content, screenshots, or keystrokes.

Multiple signals — the active app and URL (e.g. claude.ai, ChatGPT), IDE plugin events (Copilot accept, Cursor agent), and clipboard heuristics for pasted code from AI windows. All classification happens on your machine.
Yes. The backend is Go, dashboard is React, storage is Postgres + ClickHouse + Redis. Docker compose works out of the box. You can run the entire stack on a single VM.

items.q: Is my data sold or shared?
items.a: No. We don't run ads, we don't sell aggregate data, we don't train models on your events. If we ever change that, we'd ask first.
Team admins see aggregates per member. They cannot see individual prompts, files, or content. Members can pause tracking anytime and export or delete all their data.
Solo and self-hosted are free forever. Team will eventually have paid tiers — but during beta, all team features are free with no time limit.
